title: Sentry SDK Specification Compliance Manifest
description: SDK-maintained declarations of implemented specification versions and sections.

$schema.description: The schema used to validate this manifest.

sdk.description: The SDK repository identifier, for example sentry-cocoa.

last_updated.description: The date compliance declarations were last changed, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

specs.description: Compliance declarations keyed by the specification's spec_id.

version.description: An exact specification SemVer version, not an SDK release version or version range.
The highest fully implemented specification version, accounting for non-applicable sections. Use 0.0.0 until the first complete version is implemented.

sections.description: Implemented sections keyed by SpecSection id, with the latest specification version each implementation satisfies.

non_applicable.description: Entire sections that require no implementation for this SDK, keyed by SpecSection id, with a reason for each exclusion.
